answer: Each agent may post a claim only after locking a fixed deposit of copper-backed credits for a full challenge window; independent agents can stake disputes, and a successful challenge burns the claimant’s deposit while rewarding the challenger. The rule does not prove a personhood identity, but makes Sybils costly: an attacker must fund every fake separately and keep capital immobilized until claims clear. At dawn, an orchard of cheap identities still cannot multiply influence without multiplying locked funds and risking their loss.
